title: Ingredient Contracting: When the Window Opens and the Smallest Contract the Mill Will Take
content:
Ingredients may be contracted ahead only on the programmes within the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes that are open to it, and where they are, the smallest contract the mill will take and the dates between which the contracting window stands open are set by the programme.

| Programme | Ingredients may be contracted ahead | Smallest ingredient contract the mill will take | Window opens | Window closes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | no | 0.0 tons | not offered | not offered |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | no | 0.0 tons | not offered | not offered |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | no | 0.0 tons | not offered | not offered |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | yes | 100.0 tons | 1 September | 30 November |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | yes | 150.0 tons | 1 September | 30 November |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | no | 0.0 tons | not offered | not offered |

## Points of judgement on the schedule

Two of the six programmes are open to ingredient contracting, the Contracted Ingredient Program and the Full Nutrition Partner Program, and both hold the same window, opening on the first of September and closing on the thirtieth of November. What differs between them is the size of the smallest contract: a hundred tons on the Contracted Ingredient Program and a hundred and fifty on the Full Nutrition Partner Program.

*Hypothetical.* A contract of a hundred and twenty tons reaches the smallest size the schedule sets for a Contracted Ingredient Program and falls short of the size it sets for a Full Nutrition Partner Program.
